message.content:
Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles along the I‑5 corridor covers roughly **380–400 miles** (about 610–640 km). Under normal conditions—steady traffic, no major detours, and staying within speed limits—the trip typically takes **around 6 hours**.  

If you’re heading out during rush hour or on weekends, traffic can add an extra hour or two, especially near the Bay Area and the Los Angeles metro area. Conversely, if you’re traveling on a clear day with minimal stops, you might get there closer to the 5‑hour mark. Always check a live navigation app for real‑time traffic updates before you hit the road.

We can provide approximate distance (~383 miles via I-5) and typical driving time (~6 hours). But we might also mention traffic, speed limits, etc. There's no function call needed. Just answer.
